title: 第25章 调戏云霜儿我想做好人第26章 是为苗小柔盗灵药
lines: 云海四霸，云海宗内最出名的纨绔团伙。
他们吃喝嫖赌，坑蒙拐骗，除了好事，他们什么都做。
在云海宗的名声极差。
老大【欺男霸女】叶风，又名叶正一，今年十六岁，云海宗四阶长老玉龙上人的大弟子，
老二【欺行霸市】方同，又名方正仙，今年十五岁，云海宗三阶长老云石上人的入室小弟子。
老三【独霸一方】诸葛奔雷，又名诸葛元浩，今年十五岁，云海宗知客院首席长老诸葛云涛的独子。
老四【横行霸道】齐瑶，又名齐静仙，今年十五岁，云海宗传功院首席大长老玄池仙子的孙女。
都说人以类聚，物以群分，这四个小家伙在数年前开始勾搭在一起。
仗着自已有靠山，在星罗峰上肆无忌惮，聚众赌博，打架斗殴，调戏女弟子，偷盗法宝，整蛊同门……可谓是无恶不作。
好好的正道仙门云海宗，被这四人搞的乌烟瘴气。
奈何他们的长辈都是云海宗的高层，被欺负的云海宗弟子，都是敢怒不敢言。
在任何小说中，以叶风为首的云海四霸，都会被打上人渣，败类，坏蛋，反派等标签。
这些角色的结局往往都是被代表正义的男女主角给一刀咔嚓了。
好人有好人的道义。
反派也有反派的义气。
方同等人就很讲义气，得知自已的带头大哥失忆了，灵儿妹妹又初来乍到，于是乎，三人便拽着叶风二人出门，说要好好给二人介绍云海宗。
一来，或许可以让叶风恢复丢失的记忆。
二来，也可以让黄灵儿尽快熟悉云海宗的生活。
玉龙道人出门前，嘱咐他们不要随意出门，不过这都是自家兄弟，叶风也不太相信，那个凶手会在光天化日之下行凶，于是便跟着三个坏蛋朋友出门了。
以前都是根据云霜儿与老狱友了解的云海宗，现在走在星罗峰的山腰道路上，叶风更加直观的了解了这个历经四千多年岁月而没有衰落的古老大派。
云海宗很大，有内门弟子八千余人，外门弟子三万余人。
其中，五成以上的弟子，都是生活在星罗峰上的。
从山脚到山腰的山阳面，随处可见青砖房舍，一排排的，就像是梯田一般。
除了星罗峰外，周围虚悬着的那几百个大大小小的悬浮山上，也有不少弟子或者长老在上面生活。
其中有四座悬浮山，非常的巨大，正好分列星罗峰的四个方向。
分别是东面的青灵峰，南面的赤云峰，西面的玄珠峰，北面的天星峰。
这四座悬浮山上，都有数百名长老弟子生活。
被誉为云海四脉。
四峰上的首席长老，又被称之为四脉首座。
在云海宗地位非常的高。
“快走！
快走！
云海四霸出来啦！”
“这四个恶霸怎么又聚在一起了！”
“叶风……叶风那人渣回到星罗峰了！”
“走走走……”
五人所过之处，遇到的云海宗弟子，有的绕行，有的低头。
content_en:
The Four Hegemons of Yunhai are the most famous gang of dudes in Yunhai Sect.
They eat, drink, whore, gamble, cheat and kidnap. They do everything but good deeds.
His reputation in Yunhai Sect is extremely bad.
The boss [Bullying men and dominating women] Ye Feng, also known as Ye Zhengyi, is sixteen years old this year and is the eldest disciple of Master Yulong, the fourth-level elder of Yunhai Sect.
The second child [Bullying and Dominating] Fang Tong, also known as Fang Zhengxian, is fifteen years old this year and the disciple of Master Yunshi, the third-level elder of Yunhai Sect.
The third child [dominating one side] Zhuge Benlei, also known as Zhuge Yuanhao, is fifteen years old this year and the only son of Zhuge Yuntao, the chief elder of the Yunhai Zongzhiguyuan.
The Fourth [Domineering] Qi Yao, also known as Qi Jingxian, is fifteen years old this year and the granddaughter of Xuanchi Fairy, the chief elder of the Yunhai Zongchuan Gongyuan.
They say birds of a feather flock together, and these four little guys started hooking up a few years ago.
Relying on the fact that he had a backer, he acted unscrupulously on Xingluo Peak, gathering people to gamble, fight, tease female disciples, steal magic weapons, play tricks on fellow disciples... It can be said that he did all kinds of evil.
Yunhai Sect, a good righteous immortal sect, was brought into chaos by these four people.
However, their elders are all high-level officials of the Yunhai Sect, and the bullied Yunhai Sect disciples dare not speak out in anger.
In any novel, the four tyrants of Yunhai headed by Ye Feng will be labeled as scum, scum, villains, villains, etc.
The endings of these characters are often killed by the male and female protagonists who represent justice.
Good people have the morality of being good people.
Villains also have the loyalty of villains.
Fang Tong and others were very loyal. When they learned that their leader had lost his memory and that sister Ling'er had just arrived, the three of them dragged Ye Feng and two others out, saying that they would introduce Yunhaizong to them.
First, maybe Ye Feng can recover his lost memory.
Secondly, it can also allow Huang Ling'er to become familiar with the life of Yunhaizong as soon as possible.
Before Taoist Yulong went out, he told them not to go out casually, but these were his brothers, and Ye Feng didn't quite believe that the murderer would commit murder in broad daylight, so he followed his three bad guys out.
In the past, he only learned about Yunhai Sect from Yun Shuang'er and old inmates. Now walking on the mountainside road of Xingluo Peak, Ye Feng had a more intuitive understanding of this ancient sect that has not declined for more than four thousand years.
Yunhai Sect is very large, with more than 8,000 inner disciples and more than 30,000 outer disciples.
Among them, more than 50% of the disciples live on Xingluo Peak.
From the foot of the mountain to the sunny side of the mountain, you can see blue brick houses everywhere, rows like terraces.
In addition to Xingluo Peak, there are also many disciples or elders living on the hundreds of large and small suspended mountains hanging around.
There are four suspended mountains among them, which are very huge and are located in the four directions of Xingluo Peak.
They are Qingling Peak in the east, Chiyun Peak in the south, Xuanzhu Peak in the west, and Tianxing Peak in the north.
Hundreds of elders and disciples live on these four suspended mountains.
It is known as the four veins of the sea of ​​clouds.
The chief elder on the four peaks is also called the leader of the four veins.
His status in Yunhai Sect is very high.
"Let's go!
Go quickly!
The Four Hegemons of the Sea of Clouds are out! "
"Why are these four bullies getting together again!"
"Ye Feng...that scumbag Ye Feng has returned to Xingluo Peak!"
"Let's go, let's go..."
…
Wherever the five of them passed, some of the Yunhai Sect disciples they met walked around and some bowed their heads.
